metadata.title: Evaluate to true if the macos-def:gatekeeper_test is properly supported.
metadata.description: The definition should evaluate to true if the tool supports the macos-def:launchd_test properly and no unlabeled applications exist.

notes.note: This definition checks the functionality of the macos-def:gatekeeper_test and may require adjustment of the gatekeeper_object or gatekeeper_state paramaters based on the configuration of the system being tested.

criterion.comment: Test that the gatekeeper_test is supported with a state entity existence check of 'none exist'.

gatekeeper_test.comment: Test that the gatekeeper_test is supported with a state entity 'enabled' of '1' and 'unlabeled' existence check of 'none exist'.

gatekeeper_state.comment: Confirm 'enabled' is '1' and no 'unlabeled' application paths are identified.
